_readme: GPU/RAM memory profiles for sharing the GPU between ComfyUI and Ollama (chat). The app reads the GPU's total VRAM at startup (nvidia-smi, or ComfyUI /system_stats) and picks the profile with the highest minVramMB that is <= total VRAM. Override: set "profile" here, pick one in the app (menu > GPU & memory), or set env MEMORY_PROFILE. Precedence: env > app setting > this file > auto. Edits here are picked up without a restart. All sizes are MiB.

ram._readme: System RAM is spill/cache room (models offloaded from VRAM). A chat model is refused if it would not fit in free VRAM + (free RAM - reserveMB), so nothing is pushed to the page file.

profiles.label: Under 12 GB VRAM (e.g. RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB)

workflowVramNeedMB._readme: Free VRAM a ComfyUI job wants when it is queued, per preset id, 'ai:<id>' (AI Workflow presets; default = the preset's own vram.estMB) or 'action:<id>' (2080 Ti measurements: Flux.2 klein 1 MP peaks ~6.8-7.5 GB total once loaded; upscale ~7.0 GB; Hunyuan3D 2.1 ~9.3 GB). On the 'if-needed' profile Ollama is unloaded only when free VRAM minus headroomMB is below this. ComfyUI itself offloads its own models to RAM when VRAM is short.
